Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 1b, 1c, and 1d) demonstrate extraluminal air tracking along the mediastinal structures, specifically around the descending aorta and esophagus, which is characteristic of pneumomediastinum. In a young patient without stated trauma, this is most consistent with spontaneous pneumomediastinum caused by alveolar rupture due to increased intraalveolar pressure (Macklin effect).
